of Presidential Decree No. 1745, dated November 20, 1980 is hereby amended to read as
"Sec. 11. Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect immediately except that the provisions of Sections 3, 4 and
5 hereof shall take effect on February 1, 1981 so as to provide for adequate dissemination to the public of the
necessary information pertaining to the contents thereof and the mechanics therefor.
Done in the City of Manila, Philippines, this 4th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
